CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem.
   C. Use Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Work: God Worked? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Work: God Worked with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Work: God Worked has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work: God Worked.
   D. Use Work: God Worked to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T? (1 mark)
   A. Use Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T.
   D. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Christian Moral Values: Purity? (1 mark)

   D. Say Christian Moral Values: Purity has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ.
   B. Use Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes? (1 mark)
   A. Say Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Parable on prayer Midnight? (1 mark)

9. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Which response best shows understanding of Kings David and Solomon? (1 mark)

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)

   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
